scenarios.goal: Post a message to a channel. This scenario needs an authenticated Slack session and the network; it is reported as NOT_RUN without them and must never be recorded as PASS offline.

steps.note: open the channel (unauthenticated access lands on the sign-in page, so this cannot pass offline)
the message composer is only rendered for a signed-in member

argv: Benchmark check-in: posting from the automation harness.

steps.note: the channel transcript now shows the posted text

scenarios.goal: Reply in a thread. Like B12 this needs an authenticated session and the network; without them the scenario is NOT_RUN, never PASS.

steps.note: open an existing thread in the channel
the thread reply composer is only rendered for a signed-in member

argv: Thread reply from the automation harness.

steps.note: the thread now shows the reply

expect.stdoutContains: Thread reply from the automation harness
